definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'method: A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 describes the same entity in 9.3.4 instead of its definitions clause. GR9 speaks of 'the invoked method', the same entity.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:9.3.5 binds a method by name only ("if a method with the method-name specified in the invocation is defined in the class of the object, that method is bound"); 2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching (overloading). In 2002 the invoked method is the one of that name, so GR9's requirement (the omitted-argument condition true in it, for OMITTED and for omitted trailing arguments) applies to the same method a 2002 program can have; 2023's signature resolution only adds choices among overloads 2002 cannot declare. pb757_invoke_omitted passes at --std 2002.
